name: Past Paper
statement: Given that $\mathbf{x}_1,\mathbf{x}_2,\ldots ,\mathbf{x}_{10}$ are positive integers such that $\mathbf{x}_1< \mathbf{x}_2< \mathbf{x}_3< \ldots < \mathbf{x}_{10}$ and $\mathbf{x}_1 + \mathbf{x}_2 + \ldots +\mathbf{x}_{10} = 2006$, find the greatest possible value of $\mathbf{x}_5$.
